name: Creative Graphics Solutions India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2014, Creative Graphics Solutions is in the business of processing of Polymer Plates and Trading of Inks[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
CGSIL manufactures Printing blocks (Photopolymer plates) for flexographic, lever press & dry offset machines. It is a pre-press company, engaged in manufacturing of flexographic printing plates including Digital Flexo Plates, Conventional Flexo Printing Plates, Lever Press Plates, Metal Back Plates, and Coating Plates.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 35.5%
cons: Working capital days have increased from 34.2 days to 74.8 days
